answer_1.outputs: The paper generates code solutions for programming problems in HumanEval and multi-turn dialogue responses in MT-Bench.

answer_2.quote: The first metric we use is Mean Token Time, which is the average generation time of one token for the LLM. Another metric, Mean Generated Length, is calculated as the ratio of the length of the generated tokens to the number of forward steps taken by the original LLM.
